In 1894, the ETV&G merged with the Richmond and Danville Railroad to form the Southern Railway.

Today it was now operated by NS.

Maryville, Tennessee | Maryville is a city and the county seat of Blount County, Tennessee, in the southeastern United States.  Maryville's population was 27,465 at the 2010 census.  It is included in the Knoxville Metropolitan Area.
Callaways Little Island | Callaways Little Island, or Kirkland Island, is a small island 1.4 miles WSW of Tallassee, Tennessee within the Chilhowee Shoals of the Little Tennessee River, Monroe County, Tennessee.  There is another Kirkland Island in British Columbia, Canada.
